# name

Name or rename an existing authentication profile

## Usage

```
ppds auth name [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--index` | `-i` | `int` |  | The index of the profile to be named/renamed |
| `--name` | `-n` | `string` |  | The name you want to give to this authentication profile (maximum 30 characters) |
